measurementRules.rule: Q = sum of independently weighed complete newly first-released net deck masses for the actual cohort; exclude removable packaging. Released closing FG is already in Q. Do not infer deck mass from nominal card count, dimensions, grammage or boxed gross weight.

Preserve each actual kg/MJ/kWh/m3/h numerator independently. Energy is not Mass. Convert raw units before attribution; integrated volumes are not rates. Density requires independent measurement of that substance and state; no secondary-property inference. Number of items to item has factor 1 only as a physical unit alias and never supplies kg per deck.

Protocols collect raw quantities only. c_once is the only division by cohort Q; every card and aggregation refers to that same result. Full gross physical leg V is never replaced by a stock-corrected, economic or service-burden numerator. Provider burden A is a separate dimension with one-time ownership. Q=0 keeps actual loads without a unit result.

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum of actual newly first-quality-released complete net deck masses; exclude packaging and any previously released deck. Closing released FG is within Q.

Convert each raw extensive quantity to its actual native reference unit before attribution. For electricity E_MJ = 3.6 * E_kWh; integrated volumes stay volumes; true rates alone are integrated; substance-specific measured density and state are needed for mass/volume conversion.

Keep physical V complete and independent. For each exchange j: L_open,j + L_new,j = A_cohort,j + A_true_other,j + L_close,j. L_close includes only actual raw/WIP/unassigned non-WIP and genuinely unused service charge, never released closing FG or performed service. If a collected load is already stock-corrected consumed load do not apply opening/closing again. Genuine other-function transfer requires justified allocation/handover once; ordinary waste/reject/sample sales are not A_true_other.  L_new is the new burden addition before stock correction; an already consumed load uses its reconciled equivalent ledger without repeating stock corrections or provider-expanded history.

q_phys=V/Qanalysis is only physical disclosure of the once-only full actual event using a declared positive observation basis. Linked modeled demand is the separately evidenced attributable vector A/Q0 or A_h/original_Qc per each original positive cohort in compatible provider units, exactly once. Never charge full shared Qt/provider quantity again to every cohort or scale physical V by service allocation. Zero/unknown basis preserves raw totals without unit result.

For each same-unit actual whole-wet pool: O+P+I+ER+J_in+H2O_in=C+S_filled+EO_empty+W_whole+J_out+H2O_out. J and H2O are actual disjoint repair/retained increments and departures. X_in/out only reconcile duplicate OTHER same-side constituent terms before this equation; X is not another added physical stream and never erases true P/I/ER, wet C, opposite flows or real retained influx. Whole W includes nested substrate/residue/water once, linked to any substrate-only balance by composition. Internal reuse cancels; origin W in one mixed receiver is nonadditive. No normalization here.

Close each stage and combined wet-mass gate plus each relevant element using independently measured opening/closing stocks and complete actual external gross legs. Matched internal stock→print→cut→collation→first-release→FG handoffs cancel with equal physical quantities and inherited vectors. Quantitative-reference Q is not added again beside its closing FG. Do not infer water, oxygen, emission species or reaction extent from an underdetermined residual; no normalization in this rule.

measurementRules.rule: Q = 真实批次新增首次放行完整净牌组独立称重质量之和，排除可移除包装。已放行期末成品已含于 Q。不能从名义张数、尺寸、克重或盒装毛重推得牌重。
每项真实 kg/MJ/kWh/m3/h 分子独立保留，能量不是质量。原始单位先转换再归属；积分体积不是速率。密度须该物质及状态的独立测量，不能借次级属性反推。Number of items 与 item 仅物理单位别名因子 1，不能给出每副 kg。
协议只采原始量。c_once 是唯一按批次 Q 作除法的位置，每卡及汇总引用同一结果。完整毛实物腿 V 不得改为库存修正、经济或服务负荷分子。供方负荷 A 为独立维度且归属一次。Q=0 保留真实负荷而无单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: Q = 真实新增首次质量放行完整净牌组质量之和，排除包装及任何已放行牌组。已放行期末成品已含于 Q。
逐原始广延量先转为真实原生参考单位再归属。电力 E_MJ = 3.6 * E_kWh；积分体积仍为体积，只有真实速率积分；质/体积换算须该物质实测密度及状态。

实物 V 完整且独立。每交换 j：L_open,j + L_new,j = A_cohort,j + A_true_other,j + L_close,j。L_close 仅含真实原料/在制/未归属非在制库存及真正未使用服务费用，不含已放行期末成品或已执行服务。L_new 若已为库存修正消耗负荷，则不再加减期初期末。真实其他功能转移须正当分配/移交一次，普通废物/不合格/样品出售不是 A_true_other。  L_new是库存校正前新增负担，已校正消耗采用经核对等价账，不重复库存修正或供方已展开历史。
q_phys=V/Qanalysis仅为一次完整实际事件按声明正观察基准的实物展示。链接模型需求另用相容供方单位的独立有据归属向量A/Q0或A_h/原Qc，逐原正批次只除一次。不得向每批重复完整共享Qt或供方量，也不按服务分配缩实物V；零未知基准保留原量而无单位结果。

逐同单位真实整湿池：O+P+I+ER+J_in+H2O_in=C+S_filled+EO_empty+W_whole+J_out+H2O_out。J和H2O为真实互斥修补滞留增量及减量；X_in/out仅在式前核对其他同侧重复组分，X不是另加实物流，不能删真实P/I/ER、湿C、对侧或真实滞留流入。整W含基材残料水一次，并由组成桥连接任何仅基材平衡。内部复用抵消，混合接收流来源W不加总，此处不归一化。
逐阶段及合并湿质量门、各相关元素用独立实测期初期末库存和完整真实外部毛腿闭合。相等的纸板→印刷→裁切→配牌→首次放行→成品内部交接以相同实物量和继承向量抵消。定量参考 Q 不在其期末成品旁重复加计。不能由欠定残差推水、氧、排放物种或反应程度，本规则不归一化。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 完整毛资产/部件/流体变动与真实已执行服务分开记录。逐新/旧部件及湿库存独立测量，不设固定寿命、不每 kg 整机、不按经济份额缩实物质量。只有真实未使用/未归属服务费用可结转。 实际整份污染接收供方量仅记一次，另有证据的不重叠服务向量按各原服务批次及相容供方单位；真实全队列库存废物不缩量。X仅核对其他同侧重复组件，不是新增实物流入流出，真实留存修补水增量均保留。

collectionProtocols.site_scope: 真实场址及实际供方/接收方
collectionProtocols.quality_evidence: 原始量/校准/湿态/配置/来源/历史/向量；缺失明确

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 独立测量真实物种、真实湿库存、自然湿度交换及每相关元素。浓度与真实对应流在正确状态下结合；一个总质量残差不能确定两个未知物种或水/反应量。VOC/COD/NOx/PM 指标与分子及相变分开。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 匹配完整产品/材料/化学/type/路线/地域/介质及精确原生支持。普通 UUID/供方缺口不能删真实交换，不相容绑定保持缺席。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原生记录和真实供方规范

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留校准、原始仪表单位、真实配置、完整湿质量、相态、不确定性及完整原始记录，缺失不是零，不设配方/良率/密度/质量默认。
保留原取得/来源范围、真实供方/场址/时期、真实服务 H、全部条件排除、原批次及一次供方归属。技术综合不声称同一当代订单。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 来源范围及关联批次账

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 审计各真实六腿包装池及毛实物流、失败/Q=0 负荷、继承向量和元素平衡。真实终端/计量/方法证据缺口须明确 hold，不能作为成功数。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原始到类型化逐单元及语义审计
